  Sources: I read Codex source at commit `357fe24` (C = `https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/357fe240c91563c1e6c9690bb27a2e609282d615/codex-rs`) and dsh source at commit `d98f5d6` (D = `https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/d98f5d68519215da48f3002da2cb9c9d2068d81d`). For CodeBuddy I had only its directory docs and the minified npm bundle.
  
  **1. Codex CLI.** Each rollout line is `{type, payload}`, defined by `RolloutItemWire` in C/history/src/rollout_payload.rs. Which events get persisted is set in C/rollout/src/policy.rs.
  
  | Signal | Present? / shape | Source |
  |---|---|---|
  | a interrupt | Yes. `event_msg` `turn_aborted` `{turn_id, reason: interrupted\|replaced\|review_ended\|budget_limited}` | C/protocol/src/protocol.rs (`TurnAbortedEvent`); policy.rs |
  | b denied | Partly. Approval request events are not persisted. A denial shows up only as tool-output text such as "exec command rejected by user" / "patch rejected by user", or in paginated mode as `item_completed` with status `declined`. Approvals leave no record. The code itself notes that some non-user failures are also labelled as rejections. | C/core/src/tools/events.rs; C/protocol/src/items.rs |
  | c compaction | Yes. `compacted` `{message, replacement_history, window_number…}`; `response_item` `compaction` / `context_compaction`; the legacy `context_compacted` event | C/history/src/lib.rs (`CompactedItem`) |
  | d skill invoked | User-invoked: yes. `$skill` / mention puts a user-role message `<skill><name>…<path>…</skill>` in the log. Model-chosen: only inferable, from a `skills.read` tool call or a shell read of SKILL.md. Codex's internal implicit-skill detection is not written to the log. | C/ext/skills/src/fragments.rs, selection.rs, invocation.rs |
  | e skills offered | Yes. A developer message wrapped in `<skills_instructions>`, listing names, descriptions and paths | fragments.rs (`AvailableSkillsInstructions`) |
  | f rule files | Content: yes, as a user message `# AGENTS.md instructions for <dir>` `<INSTRUCTIONS>…`, plus the `world_state` snapshot `{directory, text}`. Paths: only the directory or root, not one path per file. Capped at 32 KiB by `project_doc_max_bytes`. | C/core/src/agents_md.rs; C/core/src/context/world_state/agents_md.rs |
  | g subagents | Each subagent run is its own rollout file. Its `session_meta.source` is `SubAgent::ThreadSpawn{parent_thread_id, agent_role, …}`. The spawn call is `item_completed` → `CollabAgentToolCall{receiver_thread_ids}`. The list of offered roles is only in the spawn tool's description and was not found in the log. | C/protocol/src/protocol.rs (`SubAgentSource`); items.rs |
  | h truncation | Yes. Command output over 64 KiB is cut in the middle with a marker; MCP results are capped at 64 KiB. | policy.rs |
  
  **2. DeepSeek Harness.** The first line is a header `{type:'session', id, parentSession?, origin?:'subagent', agentPreset?}` (D/packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/format.ts). Event names and shapes come from D/docs/persistence-catalog.md.
  
  | Signal | Present? / shape | Source |
  |---|---|---|
  | a | Yes. `turn/end` `{reason:{kind:'aborted', reason:{kind:'user'\|'parent'\|'hook'\|'disposed'}}}` | D/packages/core/session/src/types.ts |
  | b | Yes. `approval/asked {id, toolName, callId}` followed by `approval/decided {outcome:'allowed-once'\|'rejected'\|'cancelled'\|'unavailable'}` | D/packages/interaction/user-approval/src/types.ts |
  | c | Yes. `compaction/start`, `compaction/summary {summary, shadowedSeqs, model}`, `compaction/prune`, `compaction/end` | catalog |
  | d | Yes, and the two paths are distinguishable. User-explicit: `user/message` with `source.kind:'skill-invocation', name`. Model-chosen: `tool/call` with `name:'skill'`. | D/packages/skill/skill/src/index.ts; tool-skill/src/index.ts |
  | e | Yes. A message with `source.kind:'skill-catalog'` and `entries:[{name, description}]` | catalog |
  | f | Yes. `user/message` with `source.kind:'agent-instructions'` and `changes:[{path, scope, action, digest}]`; full content is in the message. Capped by `maxBytes` (64 KiB per instruction chain in the default setup). | D/packages/context/agent-instructions |
  | g | Runs: each is a separate session whose header has `parentSession`. The parent logs `subagent/catalog {childId, name, mode}` and the child logs `subagent/descriptor`. Offered list: only in the `request/header.tools` schemas. Link from the child to the exact spawning `callId`: not found. | catalog; D/packages/subagent/subagent/src/catalog.ts |
  | h | Yes. Text over the budget is replaced by head and tail plus the path to a spill file holding the full result. | D/packages/spill/spill-policy/README.md |
  
  **3. CodeBuddy Code / WorkBuddy.** I found no public source code and no documented log schema.
  
  | Signal | Finding |
  |---|---|
  | Layout | `~/.codebuddy/projects/` holds session `.jsonl` files and `tool-results/` (https://www.workbuddy.ai/docs/cli/codebuddy-dir). The bundle in npm `@tencent-ai/codebuddy-code` 2.185.0 reads `subagents/*.jsonl`, `isSidechain`, and `type` values `summary`/`topic`/`user`/`assistant`, which is the Claude Code layout. |
  | b | Probable. The bundled web UI looks for the Claude Code denial strings ("The user doesn't want to proceed with this tool use.") in tool results. |
  | a, c, d, e, f | Not found. |
  | g | Separate `subagents/*.jsonl` files are probable; the link back to the spawning call was not found. |
  | h | `tool-results/` suggests large outputs are stored outside the log; the details were not found. |
  
  Codex records most signals, but approvals are missing, model-chosen Skill use has to be inferred, and its event formats depend on the rollout mode (some events are written only in the older legacy mode, others only in the newer paginated mode), so a Session Reader must handle both. dsh is a sound target: every signal has a typed event, including whether a Skill was invoked by the user or chosen by the model, and per-file rule-file paths. CodeBuddy reads like a Claude Code clone, but every claim above comes from minified-bundle string matches, not documentation. The format should be checked against real local logs before any parsing work is planned.

questions.question: Q4: How should the unified Session define its fields? One option is to split it into a "required part" and an "optional part". The required part is what all agents have: messages, tool calls and results, metadata, Subagent Sessions. The optional part includes the Skill list, Rule Files, Skill trigger source, interruptions, rejected tool calls and compaction; when not recorded, they are marked "unknown" rather than "empty".

options.label: Required + optional, unknown and empty kept separate (Recommended)
options.description: An optional field being absent means "this agent didn't record it", an empty array means "recorded but there is none"; the Skill trigger source uses three values: user / model / unknown. Claude Code fills in all the fields this time

options.label: Keep only the fields every agent has
options.description: Simplest, but it drops the Skill list and Rule Files, so even for Claude Code we couldn't evaluate "should the Skill have triggered" or "did the Rule Item take effect"

options.label: Required part + Skill/Rule File, feedback signals added later
options.description: Don't model interruptions, rejections and compaction separately for now; leave them in the text. Smaller scope, but when Claude Code rejects a tool call it is marked in a field, and without modeling it that is lost

## Decisions already settled with the user (do not reopen)
- Session Reader turns ONE Session (path given by the caller) into one agent-independent Session object. No relevance judgement, no slicing per Skill, no Rule Item splitting, no version ids. Session discovery/filtering (skip pre-install Sessions, auto-pick new ones) is out of scope (later CLI/daemon task).
- Reads logs only: never reads SKILL.md etc. from disk, never reads Claude Code's `<uuid>/tool-results/` files (keep only what the jsonl holds).
- Shape: a required part every agent has — user messages, assistant messages, tool calls and results, timestamps, model, token usage, metadata (cwd, git branch, agent version where present), Subagent Sessions nested at the spawning tool call. An optional part — Skill list offered, Subagent list offered, Rule Files loaded (path + full content), Skill invocations with source `user | model | unknown`, interrupts, tool-call denials, compaction boundaries. An optional field that is ABSENT means "this agent does not record it"; an EMPTY array means "recorded, none happened". Grader must be able to tell these apart.
- Malformed lines and unknown record types: skip and add to a `warnings` list (line number + reason). Never throw for one bad line.
- Implement two Session Readers in this task: Claude Code and Antigravity. Codex, DeepSeek Harness, CodeBuddy are later; the common shape was designed with them in mind but do not implement or stub them.

Claude Code: `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<uuid>.jsonl`. Record `type`s include user, assistant, attachment, plus noise (api-request, api-request-blob, queue-operation, last-prompt, session-owner, ai-title, mode, file-history-snapshot, cost-state, tools-used...). attachment subtypes: `skill_listing` (names, descriptions in content, `digests`), `instructions` (files[]: path, type e.g. AutoMem/Project, content), `agent_listing_delta` (Subagents offered), `nested_memory` likely for mid-session rule files, plus others. user records carry `toolUseResult`, `toolDenialKind`, `isMeta`, `isSidechain`, `interruptedByShutdown`; assistant messages have tool_use blocks (e.g. `Skill`, `Agent`) and `message.usage`. User-typed `/skill` vs model `Skill` tool_use must be distinguished. Subagents: `<uuid>/subagents/agent-*.jsonl` with `agent-*.meta.json` {agentType, description, toolUseId, model, ...}; toolUseId links to the parent's Agent tool_use. Look at several real files in ~/.claude/projects/-home-dev-workspace-6983-skill-scope/ to confirm interrupt / compaction / slash-command shapes. Do not print secrets.
Antigravity: `~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<uuid>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl` (use this; `transcript.jsonl` truncates content at ~4KB, marked `truncated_fields`). Records: {step_index, source, type: USER_INPUT|PLANNER_RESPONSE|GENERIC|SYSTEM_MESSAGE, status, created_at, content, thinking, tool_calls[{name,args}], model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens}. Subagents: parent `.system_generated/subagents/<childId>.json` = {conversationId, subagentDescriptor{typeName, role}, state, spawnStepIndex, workspaceUris}; the child is its own brain dir `brain/<childId>/`. No Skill list and no Rule File record in the log (both → absent/unknown). Skill invocation is inferred from a `read_file` whose Path matches `.../skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (source `unknown`). No interrupt/denial records observed; verify.

- Package location/name and file layout (CLAUDE.md conventions; `@skill-scope/session-reader` is the natural choice), public functions (KISS: plain functions, e.g. one per agent), and the TypeScript types of the common Session with each field marked required/optional and which agent fills it.
- Per-reader mapping table: source record → Session field, and the list of record types deliberately ignored.
- Fixture plan: which real records to excerpt, how to sanitize, where fixtures live, and the filtered-out/malformed cases.
- TDD commit sequence (test → feat → refactor) and Definition of Done checks, incl. the security checklist items that apply (raw Session content stays local).
- Open questions you could not settle from evidence — list them, don't invent answers.
Keep it tight: no extension points, registries, or abstractions the two readers don't need. Report back a short summary (under 250 words) plus the plan path.

1	# Plan: Claude Code and Antigravity Session Readers (#8)
2	
3	Branch `feat/8-claude-code-session-reader`. Scope as settled with the user: a Session Reader turns
4	**one** Session (path given by the caller) into one agent-independent `Session` object. No relevance
5	judgement, no slicing per Skill, no Rule Item splitting, no version ids, no Session discovery or
6	filtering, no reads outside the agent's own log files (no `SKILL.md`, no Claude Code
7	`<uuid>/tool-results/`). Two readers only: Claude Code and Antigravity.
8	
9	Evidence: all record shapes below were checked on this machine on 2026-11-22 against 6 Claude Code
10	Sessions in `~/.claude/projects/-home-dev-workspace-6983-skill-scope/` (plus a type census over all
11	local projects, 57 Subagent `.meta.json` files) and all 9 Antigravity brain dirs.
12	
13	---
14	
15	## 1. Package and files
16	
17	New package `packages/session-reader`, name `@skill-scope/session-reader`, following
18	`packages/core`: `"type": "module"`, `"private": true`, `"exports": { ".": "./src/index.ts" }`,
19	`"scripts": { "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit" }`, `tsconfig.json` extending `../../tsconfig.base.json`
20	(`rootDir: src`, `include: ["src"]`). No runtime dependencies (only `node:fs/promises` and
21	`node:path`). `pnpm install` adds the workspace importer to `pnpm-lock.yaml`; nothing else changes
22	there.
23	
24	```
25	packages/session-reader/
26	  package.json
27	  tsconfig.json
28	  src/
29	    index.ts              re-exports the two functions and the types
30	    session.ts            the Session types (types only)
31	    jsonl.ts              readJsonl(path): lines → { line, record } | Warning   (used by both readers)
32	    jsonl.test.ts
33	    claude-code.ts        readClaudeCodeSession
34	    claude-code.test.ts
35	    antigravity.ts        readAntigravitySession
36	    antigravity.test.ts
37	  fixtures/               outside src/, so tsc and coverage ignore it
38	    claude-code/...
39	    antigravity/...
40	```
41	
42	`jsonl.ts` is the only shared code, because both readers need the same "split lines, `JSON.parse`,
43	warn on failure, warn when not an object" step. Nothing else is shared: no base class, no registry,
44	no reader interface type.
45	
46	### Public functions
47	
48	```ts
49	// path = the main log: ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<uuid>.jsonl
50	export function readClaudeCodeSession(path: string): Promise<Session>;
51	
52	// dir = the Session's brain dir: ~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<uuid>
53	export function readAntigravitySession(dir: string): Promise<Session>;
54	```
55	
56	- Both throw only when the main log itself cannot be read (missing file, permission). The thrown
57	  message names the path and the error code, never Session content. The caller (later CLI/daemon)
58	  skips the Session, which matches `docs/dev/security.md` A10.
59	- Every other problem (bad line, unknown record, missing Subagent file, unlinked Subagent) becomes a
60	  `warnings` entry; the reader never throws for it.
61	- Antigravity takes the brain dir rather than the log path because the Session's identity is the
62	  dir and the reader needs `<dir>/.system_generated/subagents/` and sibling brain dirs. It reads
63	  `<dir>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl` only, never `transcript.jsonl` (that file
64	  truncates fields at about 4 KB).
65	
66	---
67	
68	## 2. The common Session type (`src/session.ts`)
69	
70	Rule for optional fields: **absent** = this agent does not record it; **empty array** = the agent
71	records it and none happened. Presence depends on the agent, never on the file's contents: the
72	Claude Code reader always sets all seven optional fields (empty arrays when nothing was found); the
73	Antigravity reader sets only `skillInvocations` and `compactions`.
74	
75	```ts
76	export interface Session {
77	  agent: 'claude-code' | 'antigravity';           // required
78	  sessionId: string;                              // required; file stem / brain dir name
79	  metadata: SessionMetadata;                      // required object, fields optional
80	  events: SessionEvent[];                         // required, in log order
81	  unlinkedSubagents: SubagentSession[];           // required; Subagent logs with no spawning call found
82	  warnings: Warning[];                            // required; this Session's own log only
83	
84	  // Optional part (see presence rule above)
85	  skillsOffered?: OfferedItem[];
86	  subagentsOffered?: OfferedItem[];
87	  ruleFiles?: RuleFileLoad[];
88	  skillInvocations?: SkillInvocation[];
89	  interrupts?: Interrupt[];
90	  toolDenials?: ToolDenial[];
91	  compactions?: Compaction[];
92	}
93	
94	export interface SessionMetadata {
95	  cwd?: string;          // CC: first record's cwd. AG: absent (not in the log)
96	  gitBranch?: string;    // CC: first record's gitBranch. AG: absent
97	  agentVersion?: string; // CC: first record's `version`. AG: absent
98	}
99	
100	export type SessionEvent = UserEvent | AssistantEvent | ToolCallEvent;
101	
102	export interface UserEvent {
103	  type: 'user';
104	  timestamp: string;
105	  text: string;
106	  meta: boolean;         // true = injected by the agent (Skill body, system reminder,
107	                         // Subagent message), false = typed by the person
108	}
109	
110	export interface AssistantEvent {
111	  type: 'assistant';     // one per model response
112	  timestamp: string;
113	  text: string;          // '' when the response only made tool calls
114	  thinking?: string;     // only when the log holds non-empty thinking text
115	  model?: string;        // CC: always. AG: only when the record has `model`
116	  usage?: TokenUsage;    // CC: always. AG: on PLANNER_RESPONSE records
117	}
118	
119	export interface TokenUsage {
120	  input: number;
121	  output: number;
122	  cacheRead?: number;
123	  cacheWrite?: number;   // CC only
124	}
125	
126	export interface ToolCallEvent {
127	  type: 'tool_call';
128	  timestamp: string;
129	  id: string;            // CC: tool_use id. AG: synthesised `<line>:<n>` (step_index is not unique)
130	  name: string;
131	  input: unknown;        // raw tool input / args
132	  result?: ToolResult;   // absent = no result in the log
133	  subagent?: SubagentSession;  // set on the call that spawned it
134	}
135	
136	export interface ToolResult {
137	  timestamp: string;
138	  output: string;        // text blocks joined with '\n'; non-text blocks become '[image]'
139	  isError: boolean;
140	}
141	
142	export interface SubagentSession {
143	  subagentType?: string; // CC: meta.agentType. AG: subagentDescriptor.typeName
144	  description?: string;  // CC: meta.description. AG: subagentDescriptor.role
145	  session: Session;      // parsed with the same reader
146	}
147	
148	export interface OfferedItem { name: string; description?: string }
149	
150	export interface RuleFileLoad {
151	  path: string;
152	  kind?: string;         // agent's own label, e.g. CC 'Project', 'AutoMem' (AutoMem = MEMORY.md,
153	                         // kept here; excluded from reports downstream)
154	  content: string;       // full content as recorded in the log
155	  timestamp: string;
156	  eventIndex: number;    // number of events before it (where it sits in `events`)
157	}
158	
159	export interface SkillInvocation {
160	  name: string;
161	  source: 'user' | 'model' | 'unknown';
162	  timestamp: string;
163	  eventIndex: number;
164	  toolCallId?: string;   // when a tool call carried it
165	}
166	
167	export interface Interrupt { timestamp: string; eventIndex: number }
168	
169	export interface ToolDenial {
170	  toolCallId: string;
171	  kind: string;          // CC toolDenialKind as recorded. Known values: 'user-rejected',
172	                         // 'interrupted' (Session ended before the result), 'automode-blocked',
173	                         // 'automode-unavailable', 'permission-rule'
174	  timestamp: string;
175	}
176	
177	export interface Compaction {
178	  timestamp: string;
179	  eventIndex: number;
180	  trigger?: string;      // CC compactMetadata.trigger ('manual' | 'auto')
181	  summary?: string;      // CC isCompactSummary text; AG CHECKPOINT content
182	}
183	
184	export interface Warning { line?: number; reason: string }  // line omitted for file-level warnings
185	```
186	
187	`reason` is a fixed short description plus, at most, the record `type`/subtype name. It never
188	contains Session content.
189	
190	---
191	
192	## 3. Claude Code reader
193	
194	### Files read
195	
196	- `<dir>/<uuid>.jsonl` (main log; `sessionId` = `<uuid>`).
197	- `<dir>/<uuid>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl` and `agent-<id>.meta.json`, if the folder exists.
198	- Nothing else. `<uuid>/tool-results/` is never opened.
199	
200	### Mapping
201	
202	| Source record | Session field |
203	| --- | --- |
204	| first record with `cwd` / `gitBranch` / `version` | `metadata.cwd` / `gitBranch` / `agentVersion` |
205	| `user`, `message.content` string or `text` blocks, not `isMeta` | `UserEvent` `meta: false` (includes `<command-name>` records as typed) |
206	| `user` with `isMeta: true` (Skill body "Base directory for this skill: ...", Subagent messages, reminders) | `UserEvent` `meta: true` |
207	| `user` text exactly `[Request interrupted by user]` or `[Request interrupted by user for tool use]` | `interrupts[]` (not an event) |
208	| `user` with `isCompactSummary: true` | `summary` of the latest `compactions[]` entry (not an event) |
209	| `user` `tool_result` block | `result` of the `ToolCallEvent` with that `tool_use_id`; `is_error` → `isError` |
210	| `user` with `toolDenialKind` | `toolDenials[]` (`toolCallId` from its tool_result, `kind` as recorded) |
211	| `assistant` records | one `AssistantEvent` per `message.id`. Claude Code writes one record per content block, each repeating `usage`, and the records of one response are not always consecutive (parallel tool calls put `tool_result` user records, and once a text record plus a `command_permissions` attachment, between them; 13 cases in 5 of 6 local Sessions). So records are grouped by `message.id` across intervening records: the first record creates the `AssistantEvent`, later records append their text/thinking to it and their `tool_use` blocks as new `ToolCallEvent`s at their own position; `usage` is taken once |
212	| `assistant` `text` / `thinking` blocks | `text` / `thinking` (thinking kept only if non-empty) |
213	| `assistant` `message.model`, `message.usage` | `model`; `usage` = `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `cache_read_input_tokens`, `cache_creation_input_tokens` |
214	| `assistant` `tool_use` block | `ToolCallEvent` after its `AssistantEvent` |
215	| `tool_use` `name: "Skill"`, `input.skill` | `skillInvocations[]` `source: 'model'`, `toolCallId` set; `source: 'user'` instead when a `skill_mention` attachment with the same `skillName` appeared since the last `meta: false` user event (the user named the Skill in the prompt). A `skill_mention` with no later `Skill` call is not an invocation |
216	| `user` `<command-name>/X</command-name>` followed by an `isMeta` user record starting `Base directory for this skill:` with no `sourceToolUseID` | `skillInvocations[]` `name: X`, `source: 'user'` (built-in commands such as `/compact`, `/clear` have no such follow-up and are not Skill invocations) |
217	| `system` subtype `compact_boundary` | `compactions[]` with `trigger` from `compactMetadata.trigger` |
218	| `attachment` `skill_listing` (`names[]`, `content` lines `- name: description`) | `skillsOffered[]`, union by name in first-seen order; `isInitial: false` only adds |
219	| `attachment` `agent_listing_delta` (`addedTypes`, `addedLines`, `removedTypes`) | `subagentsOffered[]`; removals applied |
220	| `attachment` `instructions` (`files[{path, type, content}]`) | one `ruleFiles[]` entry per file per load. A record with `changed: true, reason: "session_start"` holds only the Rule Files whose content changed (after a mid-Session edit, `/clear` or compaction; e.g. `bb1de575` reloads only the `Project` file); each is kept as a further load with its new content |
221	| Subagent `agent-<id>.jsonl` | parsed with the same function → `SubagentSession`, attached to the main-log `ToolCallEvent` whose `id` equals `meta.toolUseId` |
222	| Subagent with no `meta.json`, no `toolUseId` (seen: 7 of 57 local files, spawned by slash commands), or an id not found | `unlinkedSubagents[]` + warning |
223	
224	### Deliberately ignored (no warning)
225	
226	- Top-level types: `api-request`, `api-request-blob`, `api-request-shape`, `queue-operation`,
227	  `last-prompt`, `session-owner`, `atis-latch`, `ai-title`, `mode`, `permission-mode`,
228	  `file-history-snapshot`, `file-history-delta`, `cost-state`, `tools-used`, `pr-link`,
229	  `frame-link`, `artifact-autoreact-ledger`, `artifact-comment-monitor`.
230	- `system` subtypes: `informational`, `turn_duration`, `away_summary`, `local_command`.
231	- `attachment` types: `deferred_tools_record`, `deferred_tools_delta`, `environment`,
232	  `queued_command`, `prompt_snapshot`, `edited_text_file`, `date`, `model`, `credential_org`,
233	  `session_context` (holds the user's email), `remote_session_change`, `auto_mode`,
234	  `silent_turn_reminder`, `file`, `command_permissions`, `mcp_instructions_delta`,
235	  `total_tokens_reminder`, `compact_file_reference`, `thinking_drop`, `invoked_skills` (re-injected
236	  Skill bodies after compaction, would double-count), `hook_additional_context`, `hook_success`,
237	  `task_status`, `directory`, `plan_mode_exit`, `at_mention_reference`, `skill_mention` (used only
238	  as the signal above). `hook_additional_context` can inject a full Skill body (a SessionStart
239	  hook loads `superpowers:using-superpowers`); that is not a Skill invocation.
240	- Record fields: `toolUseResult` (structured copy; the `tool_result` block is what the model saw),
241	  `interruptedByShutdown`, `isSidechain`, `digests`, `requestId`, `parentUuid` except for the
242	  slash-command link.
243	
244	Any other top-level type, `system` subtype or `attachment` type → warning `unknown record type`.
245	`nested_memory` (Rule Files loaded mid-Session from subdirectories) was not observed on this
246	machine, so it is not handled and gives that warning until a real sample exists.
247	
248	Subagent logs are linked to `Agent` calls in the main log only (only `spawnDepth: 1` was seen); a
249	deeper one lands in `unlinkedSubagents` with a warning.
250	
251	---
252	
253	## 4. Antigravity reader
254	
255	### Files read
256	
257	- `<dir>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl` (`sessionId` = dir name).
258	- `<dir>/.system_generated/subagents/<childId>.json`, if the folder exists.
259	- For each child: `<dir>/../<childId>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl`, parsed with the
260	  same function.
261	- Not read: `transcript.jsonl`, `logs/chunks/`, `messages/`, `steps/`, `tasks/`.
262	
263	### Mapping
264	
265	| Source record | Session field |
266	| --- | --- |
267	| `USER_INPUT` | `UserEvent` `meta: false`; `text` = inside `<USER_REQUEST>...</USER_REQUEST>` when present, else whole `content` (`<ADDITIONAL_METADATA>` and `<USER_SETTINGS_CHANGE>` dropped) |
268	| `SYSTEM_MESSAGE` | `UserEvent` `meta: true` (Subagent messages, the Subagent's task prompt) |
269	| `PLANNER_RESPONSE` | `AssistantEvent`: `content` → `text` (default ''), `thinking`, `model` if present, `usage` copied as recorded from `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `cache_read_tokens` (whether `input_tokens` excludes cached tokens is not documented; the numbers suggest it does) |
270	| `PLANNER_RESPONSE.tool_calls[n]` `{name, args}` | `ToolCallEvent`, `id` = `<line>:<n>` (line number in the file; `step_index` repeats, e.g. 209, 221, 223 each appear twice with tool calls in `0d43d5d0`), `input` = `args` |
271	| `GENERIC` | `result` of the oldest pending tool call of the preceding `PLANNER_RESPONSE` (positional; verified 0 mismatches over all 9 local logs); `output` = `content`, `isError` = `status === "ERROR"`; `status: "RUNNING"` (background task launched) is a normal result |
272	| `CHECKPOINT` (source `SYSTEM`, content `# Resuming from a compaction ...`) | `compactions[]` with `summary` = `content` |
273	| `read_file` call whose `args.Path` ends in `/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | `skillInvocations[]` `name`, `source: 'unknown'`, `toolCallId` |
274	| `subagents/<childId>.json` `{conversationId, subagentDescriptor{typeName, role}}` | `SubagentSession`, attached to the first `invoke_subagent` call whose result `output` contains `"conversationId": "<childId>"`. Only `invoke_subagent` results are searched: `manage_subagents` and `send_message` results also contain child ids. `spawnStepIndex` is not used: in the local sample both children of one parent carry the same value |
275	| child brain dir missing or call not found | `unlinkedSubagents[]` (if the log exists) + warning |
276	| `created_at` | `timestamp` |
277	
278	Absent for Antigravity (not recorded): `skillsOffered`, `subagentsOffered`, `ruleFiles`,
279	`interrupts`, `toolDenials`, all of `metadata`. No interrupt or denial record exists in the 9 local
280	logs (words like "cancel" appear only inside tool output).
281	
282	Ignored fields: `status` (except `ERROR`), `error` (its text is already in `content`), `media`,
283	`source`. Unknown `type` → warning. `GENERIC` with no pending tool call → warning.
284	
285	---
286	
287	## 5. Fixtures
288	
289	Location: `packages/session-reader/fixtures/`, mirroring the real layouts:

358	- `.json` fixture files must pass `prettier --check` (they are not ignored); `.jsonl` files are not
359	  touched by Prettier.
360	
361	### Filtered-out and malformed cases (hand-added)
362	
363	Claude Code `33333333`: invalid JSON line, empty line (skipped silently), a JSON array line, a
364	record with no `type`, unknown type `future-record`, unknown `attachment` type, unknown `system`
365	subtype, `assistant` whose `message.content` is not an array, a `tool_result` whose `tool_use_id`
366	matches no call, a `/clear` command (built-in, not a Skill invocation), a Skill name that only
367	appears in text (not an invocation), an `invoked_skills` attachment (not counted again).
368	Antigravity: invalid JSON line, unknown `type`, a `GENERIC` with no pending call, a
369	`PLANNER_RESPONSE` whose tool call gets no result before the next user input, the `references/`
370	read above, a missing child dir.
371	
372	---
373	
374	## 6. Test areas (detail comes from the test-case-list step)
375	
376	Per reader: required fields and event order; one `AssistantEvent` and usage taken once per Claude
377	Code `message.id`, also when other records sit between its records; Antigravity tool-call ids
378	unique with a repeated `step_index`; tool results matched (by id / by position); a changed Rule
379	File appears as a new load with its new content; each optional field's presence rule (Claude Code empty
380	arrays on the minimal file; Antigravity absent keys via `'ruleFiles' in session === false`); Skill
381	invocation sources (`model`, `user` via slash command, `user` via `skill_mention`, `unknown`); the
382	non-invocations listed above; Subagent linking and the three unlinked cases; compaction with
383	summary; interrupts and denials; every malformed case gives exactly one warning with the right line
384	number and the rest of the file still parses; warnings contain no Session text; decoy markers never
385	appear in the output; missing main log rejects with a message that contains no content.
386	`jsonl.test.ts`: line numbering (1-based, blank lines counted), CRLF, trailing newline.
387	
388	---
389	
390	## 7. TDD commit sequence
391	
392	Following the Feature workflow in `CLAUDE.md` (test list → review → test files → review → commit,
393	then implement → review → commit):
394	
395	1. `test(session-reader): failing tests for CC and Antigravity readers (#8)`
396	   Package skeleton (`package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `src/session.ts` types, `src/index.ts`, and
397	   `readJsonl`, `readClaudeCodeSession`, `readAntigravitySession`, each
398	   `throw new Error('not implemented')`), all fixtures, all `*.test.ts`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` importer
399	   entry. `pnpm typecheck` passes; tests fail on assertions, not on imports.
400	2. `feat(session-reader): Claude Code Session Reader (#8)` (`jsonl.ts`, `claude-code.ts`).
401	3. `feat(session-reader): Antigravity Session Reader (#8)` (`antigravity.ts`).
402	4. `refactor(session-reader): ...` only if the code review leads to one.
403	5. `docs(repo): Session Reader parse failures and log paths (#8)`:
404	   - `docs/dev/security.md` A10: malformed lines are skipped with warnings; the whole Session is
405	     skipped only when its main log cannot be read; partial raw data is never uploaded.
406	   - `docs/explore/agent-logs.md` Antigravity row → `transcript_full.jsonl`.
407	   - `CLAUDE.md` repo-state line and planned-packages list (session-reader now exists).
408	
409	Fixing a wrong test after commit 1 is its own `test(...)` commit with the reason.
410	
411	## 8. Definition of Done
412	
413	- `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test:unit` pass; coverage ≥ 70% (aim
414	  higher: both readers are pure parsing).
415	- `pnpm audit --audit-level high` clean; no new dependencies.
416	- CI green.
417	- Security checklist items that apply:
418	  - No code path uploads anything: the package imports only `node:fs/promises` and `node:path`.
419	  - No secrets or Session content in logs, errors, tests or fixtures: warnings and thrown errors
420	    carry line numbers, record type names and paths only; fixtures sanitised as in §5 (the
421	    `session_context` attachment holding the user's email is ignored by the reader and faked in
422	    fixtures).
423	  - No shell interpolation of external input: paths go only to `fs` calls; no `child_process`.
424	  - Session content is untrusted input: the reader only copies strings, never evaluates them.
425	  - Dependencies: none added.
426	  - A10 in `docs/dev/security.md` matches the reader's behaviour (commit 5).
427	- Docs updated per commit 5.
428	
429	Not in this task: secret masking of Session content (YAGNI until the Grader sends content to a
430	model).
431	
432	---
433	
434	## 9. Open questions
435	
436	1. **Antigravity Skill reads through the shell.** Only `read_file` of `.../skills/<name>/SKILL.md`
437	   counts as a Skill invocation. A `run_command` such as `cat .../SKILL.md` would be missed. Not
438	   seen in the 9 local logs. Leave it out until a real case appears, or match it now?
439	
440	## Notes for later tasks
441

# Plan: Claude Code and Antigravity Session Readers (#8)

Branch `feat/8-claude-code-session-reader`. Scope as settled with the user: a Session Reader turns
**one** Session (path given by the caller) into one agent-independent `Session` object. No relevance
judgement, no slicing per Skill, no Rule Item splitting, no version ids, no Session discovery or
filtering, no reads outside the agent's own log files (no `SKILL.md`, no Claude Code
`<uuid>/tool-results/`). Two readers only: Claude Code and Antigravity.

Evidence: all record shapes below were checked on this machine on 2026-11-22 against 6 Claude Code
Sessions in `~/.claude/projects/-home-dev-workspace-6983-skill-scope/` (plus a type census over all
local projects, 57 Subagent `.meta.json` files) and all 9 Antigravity brain dirs.

---

## 1. Package and files

New package `packages/session-reader`, name `@skill-scope/session-reader`, following
`packages/core`: `"type": "module"`, `"private": true`, `"exports": { ".": "./src/index.ts" }`,
`"scripts": { "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit" }`, `tsconfig.json` extending `../../tsconfig.base.json`
(`rootDir: src`, `include: ["src"]`). No runtime dependencies (only `node:fs/promises` and
`node:path`). `pnpm install` adds the workspace importer to `pnpm-lock.yaml`; nothing else changes
there.

```
packages/session-reader/
  package.json
  tsconfig.json
  src/
    index.ts              re-exports the two functions and the types
    session.ts            the Session types (types only)
    jsonl.ts              readJsonl(path): lines → { line, record } | Warning   (used by both readers)
    jsonl.test.ts
    claude-code.ts        readClaudeCodeSession
    claude-code.test.ts
    antigravity.ts        readAntigravitySession
    antigravity.test.ts
  fixtures/               outside src/, so tsc and coverage ignore it
    claude-code/...
    antigravity/...
```

`jsonl.ts` is the only shared code, because both readers need the same "split lines, `JSON.parse`,
warn on failure, warn when not an object" step. Nothing else is shared: no base class, no registry,
no reader interface type.

### Public functions

```ts
// path = the main log: ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<uuid>.jsonl
export function readClaudeCodeSession(path: string): Promise<Session>;

// dir = the Session's brain dir: ~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<uuid>
export function readAntigravitySession(dir: string): Promise<Session>;
```

- Both throw only when the main log itself cannot be read (missing file, permission). The thrown
  message names the path and the error code, never Session content. The caller (later CLI/daemon)
  skips the Session, which matches `docs/dev/security.md` A10.
- Every other problem (bad line, unknown record, missing Subagent file, unlinked Subagent) becomes a
  `warnings` entry; the reader never throws for it.
- Antigravity takes the brain dir rather than the log path because the Session's identity is the
  dir and the reader needs `<dir>/.system_generated/subagents/` and sibling brain dirs. It reads
  `<dir>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl` only, never `transcript.jsonl` (that file
  truncates fields at about 4 KB).

---

## 2. The common Session type (`src/session.ts`)

Rule for optional fields: **absent** = this agent does not record it; **empty array** = the agent
records it and none happened. Presence depends on the agent, never on the file's contents: the
Claude Code reader always sets all seven optional fields (empty arrays when nothing was found); the
Antigravity reader sets only `skillInvocations` and `compactions`.

```ts
export interface Session {
  agent: 'claude-code' | 'antigravity';           // required
  sessionId: string;                              // required; file stem / brain dir name
  metadata: SessionMetadata;                      // required object, fields optional
  events: SessionEvent[];                         // required, in log order
  unlinkedSubagents: SubagentSession[];           // required; Subagent logs with no spawning call found
  warnings: Warning[];                            // required; this Session's own log only

  // Optional part (see presence rule above)
  skillsOffered?: OfferedItem[];
  subagentsOffered?: OfferedItem[];
  ruleFiles?: RuleFileLoad[];
  skillInvocations?: SkillInvocation[];
  interrupts?: Interrupt[];
  toolDenials?: ToolDenial[];
  compactions?: Compaction[];
}

export interface SessionMetadata {
  cwd?: string;          // CC: first record's cwd. AG: absent (not in the log)
  gitBranch?: string;    // CC: first record's gitBranch. AG: absent
  agentVersion?: string; // CC: first record's `version`. AG: absent
}

export type SessionEvent = UserEvent | AssistantEvent | ToolCallEvent;

export interface UserEvent {
  type: 'user';
  timestamp: string;
  text: string;
  meta: boolean;         // true = injected by the agent (Skill body, system reminder,
                         // Subagent message), false = typed by the person
}

export interface AssistantEvent {
  type: 'assistant';     // one per model response
  timestamp: string;
  text: string;          // '' when the response only made tool calls
  thinking?: string;     // only when the log holds non-empty thinking text
  model?: string;        // CC: always. AG: only when the record has `model`
  usage?: TokenUsage;    // CC: always. AG: on PLANNER_RESPONSE records
}

export interface TokenUsage {
  input: number;
  output: number;
  cacheRead?: number;
  cacheWrite?: number;   // CC only
}

export interface ToolCallEvent {
  type: 'tool_call';
  timestamp: string;
  id: string;            // CC: tool_use id. AG: synthesised `<line>:<n>` (step_index is not unique)
  name: string;
  input: unknown;        // raw tool input / args
  result?: ToolResult;   // absent = no result in the log
  subagent?: SubagentSession;  // set on the call that spawned it
}

export interface ToolResult {
  timestamp: string;
  output: string;        // text blocks joined with '\n'; non-text blocks become '[image]'
  isError: boolean;
}

export interface SubagentSession {
  subagentType?: string; // CC: meta.agentType. AG: subagentDescriptor.typeName
  description?: string;  // CC: meta.description. AG: subagentDescriptor.role
  session: Session;      // parsed with the same reader
}

export interface OfferedItem { name: string; description?: string }

export interface RuleFileLoad {
  path: string;
  kind?: string;         // agent's own label, e.g. CC 'Project', 'AutoMem' (AutoMem = MEMORY.md,
                         // kept here; excluded from reports downstream)
  content: string;       // full content as recorded in the log
  timestamp: string;
  eventIndex: number;    // number of events before it (where it sits in `events`)
}

export interface SkillInvocation {
  name: string;
  source: 'user' | 'model' | 'unknown';
  timestamp: string;
  eventIndex: number;
  toolCallId?: string;   // when a tool call carried it
}

export interface Interrupt { timestamp: string; eventIndex: number }

export interface ToolDenial {
  toolCallId: string;
  kind: string;          // CC toolDenialKind as recorded. Known values: 'user-rejected',
                         // 'interrupted' (Session ended before the result), 'automode-blocked',
                         // 'automode-unavailable', 'permission-rule'
  timestamp: string;
}

export interface Compaction {
  timestamp: string;
  eventIndex: number;
  trigger?: string;      // CC compactMetadata.trigger ('manual' | 'auto')
  summary?: string;      // CC isCompactSummary text; AG CHECKPOINT content
}

export interface Warning { line?: number; reason: string }  // line omitted for file-level warnings
```

`reason` is a fixed short description plus, at most, the record `type`/subtype name. It never
contains Session content.

---

## 3. Claude Code reader

### Files read

- `<dir>/<uuid>.jsonl` (main log; `sessionId` = `<uuid>`).
- `<dir>/<uuid>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl` and `agent-<id>.meta.json`, if the folder exists.
- Nothing else. `<uuid>/tool-results/` is never opened.

### Mapping

| Source record | Session field |
| --- | --- |
| first record with `cwd` / `gitBranch` / `version` | `metadata.cwd` / `gitBranch` / `agentVersion` |
| `user`, `message.content` string or `text` blocks, not `isMeta` | `UserEvent` `meta: false` (includes `<command-name>` records as typed) |
| `user` with `isMeta: true` (Skill body "Base directory for this skill: ...", Subagent messages, reminders) | `UserEvent` `meta: true` |
| `user` text exactly `[Request interrupted by user]` or `[Request interrupted by user for tool use]` | `interrupts[]` (not an event) |
| `user` with `isCompactSummary: true` | `summary` of the latest `compactions[]` entry (not an event) |
| `user` `tool_result` block | `result` of the `ToolCallEvent` with that `tool_use_id`; `is_error` → `isError` |
| `user` with `toolDenialKind` | `toolDenials[]` (`toolCallId` from its tool_result, `kind` as recorded) |
| `assistant` records | one `AssistantEvent` per `message.id`. Claude Code writes one record per content block, each repeating `usage`, and the records of one response are not always consecutive (parallel tool calls put `tool_result` user records, and once a text record plus a `command_permissions` attachment, between them; 13 cases in 5 of 6 local Sessions). So records are grouped by `message.id` across intervening records: the first record creates the `AssistantEvent`, later records append their text/thinking to it and their `tool_use` blocks as new `ToolCallEvent`s at their own position; `usage` is taken once |
| `assistant` `text` / `thinking` blocks | `text` / `thinking` (thinking kept only if non-empty) |
| `assistant` `message.model`, `message.usage` | `model`; `usage` = `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `cache_read_input_tokens`, `cache_creation_input_tokens` |
| `assistant` `tool_use` block | `ToolCallEvent` after its `AssistantEvent` |
| `tool_use` `name: "Skill"`, `input.skill` | `skillInvocations[]` `source: 'model'`, `toolCallId` set; `source: 'user'` instead when a `skill_mention` attachment with the same `skillName` appeared since the last `meta: false` user event (the user named the Skill in the prompt). A `skill_mention` with no later `Skill` call is not an invocation |
| `user` `<command-name>/X</command-name>` followed by an `isMeta` user record starting `Base directory for this skill:` with no `sourceToolUseID` | `skillInvocations[]` `name: X`, `source: 'user'` (built-in commands such as `/compact`, `/clear` have no such follow-up and are not Skill invocations) |
| `system` subtype `compact_boundary` | `compactions[]` with `trigger` from `compactMetadata.trigger` |
| `attachment` `skill_listing` (`names[]`, `content` lines `- name: description`) | `skillsOffered[]`, union by name in first-seen order; `isInitial: false` only adds |
| `attachment` `agent_listing_delta` (`addedTypes`, `addedLines`, `removedTypes`) | `subagentsOffered[]`; removals applied |
| `attachment` `instructions` (`files[{path, type, content}]`) | one `ruleFiles[]` entry per file per load. A record with `changed: true, reason: "session_start"` holds only the Rule Files whose content changed (after a mid-Session edit, `/clear` or compaction; e.g. `bb1de575` reloads only the `Project` file); each is kept as a further load with its new content |
| Subagent `agent-<id>.jsonl` | parsed with the same function → `SubagentSession`, attached to the main-log `ToolCallEvent` whose `id` equals `meta.toolUseId` |
| Subagent with no `meta.json`, no `toolUseId` (seen: 7 of 57 local files, spawned by slash commands), or an id not found | `unlinkedSubagents[]` + warning |

### Deliberately ignored (no warning)

- Top-level types: `api-request`, `api-request-blob`, `api-request-shape`, `queue-operation`,
  `last-prompt`, `session-owner`, `atis-latch`, `ai-title`, `mode`, `permission-mode`,
  `file-history-snapshot`, `file-history-delta`, `cost-state`, `tools-used`, `pr-link`,
  `frame-link`, `artifact-autoreact-ledger`, `artifact-comment-monitor`.
- `system` subtypes: `informational`, `turn_duration`, `away_summary`, `local_command`.
- `attachment` types: `deferred_tools_record`, `deferred_tools_delta`, `environment`,
  `queued_command`, `prompt_snapshot`, `edited_text_file`, `date`, `model`, `credential_org`,
  `session_context` (holds the user's email), `remote_session_change`, `auto_mode`,
  `silent_turn_reminder`, `file`, `command_permissions`, `mcp_instructions_delta`,
  `total_tokens_reminder`, `compact_file_reference`, `thinking_drop`, `invoked_skills` (re-injected
  Skill bodies after compaction, would double-count), `hook_additional_context`, `hook_success`,
  `task_status`, `directory`, `plan_mode_exit`, `at_mention_reference`, `skill_mention` (used only
  as the signal above). `hook_additional_context` can inject a full Skill body (a SessionStart
  hook loads `superpowers:using-superpowers`); that is not a Skill invocation.
- Record fields: `toolUseResult` (structured copy; the `tool_result` block is what the model saw),
  `interruptedByShutdown`, `isSidechain`, `digests`, `requestId`, `parentUuid` except for the
  slash-command link.

Any other top-level type, `system` subtype or `attachment` type → warning `unknown record type`.
`nested_memory` (Rule Files loaded mid-Session from subdirectories) was not observed on this
machine, so it is not handled and gives that warning until a real sample exists.

Subagent logs are linked to `Agent` calls in the main log only (only `spawnDepth: 1` was seen); a
deeper one lands in `unlinkedSubagents` with a warning.

---

## 4. Antigravity reader

### Files read

- `<dir>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl` (`sessionId` = dir name).
- `<dir>/.system_generated/subagents/<childId>.json`, if the folder exists.
- For each child: `<dir>/../<childId>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl`, parsed with the
  same function.
- Not read: `transcript.jsonl`, `logs/chunks/`, `messages/`, `steps/`, `tasks/`.

### Mapping

| Source record | Session field |
| --- | --- |
| `USER_INPUT` | `UserEvent` `meta: false`; `text` = inside `<USER_REQUEST>...</USER_REQUEST>` when present, else whole `content` (`<ADDITIONAL_METADATA>` and `<USER_SETTINGS_CHANGE>` dropped) |
| `SYSTEM_MESSAGE` | `UserEvent` `meta: true` (Subagent messages, the Subagent's task prompt) |
| `PLANNER_RESPONSE` | `AssistantEvent`: `content` → `text` (default ''), `thinking`, `model` if present, `usage` copied as recorded from `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `cache_read_tokens` (whether `input_tokens` excludes cached tokens is not documented; the numbers suggest it does) |
| `PLANNER_RESPONSE.tool_calls[n]` `{name, args}` | `ToolCallEvent`, `id` = `<line>:<n>` (line number in the file; `step_index` repeats, e.g. 209, 221, 223 each appear twice with tool calls in `0d43d5d0`), `input` = `args` |
| `GENERIC` | `result` of the oldest pending tool call of the preceding `PLANNER_RESPONSE` (positional; verified 0 mismatches over all 9 local logs); `output` = `content`, `isError` = `status === "ERROR"`; `status: "RUNNING"` (background task launched) is a normal result |
| `CHECKPOINT` (source `SYSTEM`, content `# Resuming from a compaction ...`) | `compactions[]` with `summary` = `content` |
| `read_file` call whose `args.Path` ends in `/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | `skillInvocations[]` `name`, `source: 'unknown'`, `toolCallId` |
| `subagents/<childId>.json` `{conversationId, subagentDescriptor{typeName, role}}` | `SubagentSession`, attached to the first `invoke_subagent` call whose result `output` contains `"conversationId": "<childId>"`. Only `invoke_subagent` results are searched: `manage_subagents` and `send_message` results also contain child ids. `spawnStepIndex` is not used: in the local sample both children of one parent carry the same value |
| child brain dir missing or call not found | `unlinkedSubagents[]` (if the log exists) + warning |
| `created_at` | `timestamp` |

Absent for Antigravity (not recorded): `skillsOffered`, `subagentsOffered`, `ruleFiles`,
`interrupts`, `toolDenials`, all of `metadata`. No interrupt or denial record exists in the 9 local
logs (words like "cancel" appear only inside tool output).

Ignored fields: `status` (except `ERROR`), `error` (its text is already in `content`), `media`,
`source`. Unknown `type` → warning. `GENERIC` with no pending tool call → warning.

---

## 5. Fixtures

Location: `packages/session-reader/fixtures/`, mirroring the real layouts:

```
fixtures/claude-code/projects/-home-user-example/
  11111111-...jsonl                         main Session
  11111111-.../subagents/agent-a1.jsonl     linked (meta.toolUseId matches an Agent call)
  11111111-.../subagents/agent-a1.meta.json
  11111111-.../subagents/agent-a2.jsonl     meta without toolUseId (slash-command spawn) → unlinked
  11111111-.../subagents/agent-a2.meta.json
  11111111-.../subagents/agent-a3.jsonl     no meta.json → unlinked + warning
  11111111-.../tool-results/decoy.txt       marker string that must never appear in output
  22222222-...jsonl                         minimal Session: one prompt, one answer, no listings
                                            → optional fields are empty arrays, not absent
  33333333-...jsonl                         malformed lines only around one valid exchange
fixtures/antigravity/brain/
  aaaaaaaa-.../.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl
  aaaaaaaa-.../.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl      decoy with a marker, must not be read
  aaaaaaaa-.../.system_generated/subagents/bbbbbbbb-....json linked child
  aaaaaaaa-.../.system_generated/subagents/cccccccc-....json child dir missing → warning
  bbbbbbbb-.../.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl
```

### What to excerpt

Claude Code, from `59d215f4`, `43aaaea5`, `9e0330ca`, `5818de65` (all this repo's own Sessions):
start-of-Session attachments (`skill_listing`, `agent_listing_delta`, `instructions` with a
`Project` and an `AutoMem` file, one `session_context`), a human prompt with `skill_mention` →
`Skill` tool_use → "Launching skill" result → `isMeta` Skill body with `sourceToolUseID`; a
`<command-name>/supermatt:grill-with-docs</command-name>` record → `isMeta` Skill body without
`sourceToolUseID`; a `/compact` command → `compact_boundary` → `isCompactSummary` → reloaded
`instructions`; an assistant response split over 2–3 records sharing `message.id`; a `tool_result`
with array content incl. an image block; a `user-rejected` denial followed by `[Request interrupted
by user for tool use]`; a `toolDenialKind: "interrupted"` result; an `Agent` tool_use with
`async_launched` result and the matching Subagent log; one of each ignored type; an `isMeta`
"Another Claude session sent a message" record; one `<synthetic>` assistant record.

Antigravity, from `9b255714` (parent with two Subagents) and `bacdc140` (child): `USER_INPUT` with
`<ADDITIONAL_METADATA>` and `<USER_SETTINGS_CHANGE>`, a `PLANNER_RESPONSE` with several parallel
`read_file` calls and their `GENERIC` results, `invoke_subagent` + "Created the following subagent"
result, a `SYSTEM_MESSAGE`, a `GENERIC` with `status: "ERROR"` and one with `"RUNNING"`, a
`PLANNER_RESPONSE` without `model`, a `CHECKPOINT`, and a `read_file` of
`.../skills/antigravity_guide/SKILL.md` plus one of `.../skills/antigravity_guide/references/cli.md`
(must not count), a `send_message` result naming a child id (must not be used for linking), and two
`PLANNER_RESPONSE` records with tool calls sharing one `step_index` (ids must stay unique).

Claude Code also needs: one response whose records are split by a `tool_result` user record (from
parallel tool calls), checking one `AssistantEvent`, usage counted once and correct tool-call
order; an `instructions` record with `changed: true, reason: "session_start"` that reloads only the
`Project` file with new content (a new load, the `AutoMem` load untouched); a `skill_mention` with
no later `Skill` call (as in `b5f763cf`, where the model ran Bash instead), which must not count.

### Sanitising (done by hand, reviewed in the test review step)

- Replace `/home/dev` with `/home/user`, project names and repo names (`skill-scope`, `Jevwright`,
  `6983`) with `example`; slug dirs accordingly.
- Replace all free text (prompts, answers, thinking, tool output, Rule File content, Skill bodies,
  listing descriptions) with short neutral English placeholders that keep the structure the reader
  depends on (`<command-name>`, `Base directory for this skill:`, `<USER_REQUEST>`, `Created the
  following subagent:` JSON, `# Resuming from a compaction`).
- Drop `prompt_snapshot`, `api-request-blob` bodies, `hook_additional_context` bodies; keep one
  record of each ignored type with placeholder fields only.
- `session_context` email → `user@example.com`; `credential_org` / organisation UUIDs and plugin
  cache paths → fixed fake UUIDs. Session, tool, `requestId` and `promptId` values replaced with
  fake ids of the same shape.

A fresh agent costs more than it looks.
